cohort: Women completing the Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale at 24-28 weeks of gestation and 6 weeks postpartum at a suburban integrated health system with approximately 5,000 annual deliveries on two hospital campuses
finding: Among perinatal women screened for depression, 3.8% reported suicidal ideation, but only 1.1% of this subgroup was at high risk for suicide.
mod_finding: Planned cesarean delivery was negatively associated with suicidal ideation risk, while severe vaginal laceration was positively associated with suicidal ideation risk.
